dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You haven't made a full recovery yet?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Not yet. I still cough at times, but I'm much better than before.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I want to get well soon... That way, I won't burden Anthony and the others any further.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I'd also be able to do some things that I want to do as well.
